query: Who nominated the only Featured Article on English Wikipedia about a dinosaur that was promoted in November 2016?

answer_raw.final_answer: It was nominated by the Wikipedia user FunkMonk.

tasks.description: Find the Featured Articles on English Wikipedia that were promoted in November 2016, specifically about dinosaurs.

result.query: Find the Featured Articles on English Wikipedia that were promoted in November 2016, specifically about dinosaurs.

facts.fact: The only Featured Article on English Wikipedia about a dinosaur that was promoted in November 2016 is Giganotosaurus.
Giganotosaurus was promoted as a Featured Article on November 19, 2016.
The article Giganotosaurus was nominated by the user FunkMonk.

result.summary: In November 2016, the dinosaur article Giganotosaurus was promoted to Featured Article status on Wikipedia, with its nomination submitted by user FunkMonk.
